title: Hardcoded API Key Backdoor Prefix ('gdg_live_*') Grants Immediate Super Admin Access
description: getApiAuthContext accepts any Authorization/x-api-key header matching the hardcoded secret or starting with the prefix 'gdg_live_'. Supplying any arbitrary string like 'gdg_live_attacker' immediately authenticates the client as an active super_admin.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Send GET or POST to /api/forms/[id] with header 'x-api-key: gdg_live_any_attacker_token'. 2. Inspect returned response status.
expected_behavior: Request should be rejected with 401 Unauthorized unless a cryptographically valid, database-registered API key is provided.
observed_behavior: Request succeeds with status 200, granting full super_admin access to form definitions, responses, and settings.
remediation: Removed wildcard prefix check and hardcoded keys. System now validates strictly against FORMS_API_KEY environment variable.
business_impact: Complete system compromise: unauthorized external actors can read all submitted personal data, tamper with forms, and alter system configurations.

cwe: CWE-328: Use of Weak Hash / CWE-798: Hardcoded Fallback Secret
title: Insecure 32-Bit Linear Polynomial Session Hash with Hardcoded Fallback Secret Enables Session Forgery
description: SESSION_SECRET falls back to a public static string ('gdg_nctu_session_hmac_secret_2026_enterprise') when the environment variable is not defined. Furthermore, createSessionSignature computes a weak 32-bit polynomial hash instead of cryptographic HMAC. verifySessionSignature accepts this weak hash, enabling offline forgery of super_admin sessions.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Compute offline 32-bit polynomial hash for userId, role='super_admin', and arbitrary token using the fallback secret. 2. Send request with forged cookies gdg_session_user, gdg_session_role=super_admin, gdg_auth_token, and gdg_session_sig. 3. System verifies signature as valid.
expected_behavior: Signatures must strictly use HMAC-SHA256 with an environment-enforced secret that fails closed if missing. Linear hashes must be rejected.
observed_behavior: Offline forged signature is validated successfully, granting super_admin access.
remediation: Replaced linear polynomial hash with cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 and constant-time verification (timingSafeEqual).
business_impact: Total unauthenticated horizontal and vertical privilege escalation across all user profiles and administrative functions.

cwe: CWE-602: Client-Side Enforcement of Server-Side Security
title: Client-Supplied visible_question_ids Bypasses Server-Side Validation on Public Form Submissions
description: The public submission API accepts visible_question_ids directly from the client request JSON payload without server validation. If an attacker submits an empty array, validateFormSubmission skips all required questions, numeric constraints, regex patterns, and file limits.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Identify a published form with mandatory questions. 2. Send POST /api/forms/public/[slug] with answers={} and visible_question_ids=[]. 3. Observe validation bypass.
expected_behavior: The server must independently execute evaluateLogicRules against the submitted answers and form schema to derive the genuine set of visible questions.
observed_behavior: Server accepts the submission without performing validation on required questions.
remediation: Server now derives visible questions server-side using evaluateLogicRules and enforces validation checks on all required fields.
business_impact: Data corruption, spam injection, submission of empty mandatory records, and circumvention of quiz assessment requirements.

title: Edge Middleware Authorization Gap on Restricted Application Routes
description: Next.js Edge Proxy (proxy.ts) only enforces access checks on strictlyAdminRoutes = ['/audit-log']. Although canAccessRoute is imported, it is never executed. Restricted routes such as /members, /incidents, /feedback, /reports, and /hr-kpis are not protected at the Edge layer.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Request restricted route (e.g., /en/members) with cookie gdg_session_role=member directly via curl. 2. Verify proxy allows request to pass to the Next.js render tree without Edge redirect.
expected_behavior: Edge middleware should execute canAccessRoute(pathname, role) and immediately redirect unauthorized roles to /en/dashboard with 307.
observed_behavior: Proxy passes the request through without Edge-level role verification.
remediation: Integrated canAccessRoute in proxy.ts to validate the user's role against requested route patterns and redirect unauthorized traffic at the Edge.
business_impact: Potential information leakage and SSR payload exposure if client-side authorization components fail or are bypassed.

title: Production OAuth Client Secret Committed into Git History
description: The genuine Google OAuth client secret (GOCSPX-***) was permanently committed to the repository history in .env.local.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Run git log -p .env.local. 2. Observe plain-text Google Client Secret in commit diffs.
expected_behavior: Secrets should never be committed into source control; .env.local must be strictly gitignored.
observed_behavior: Live secret credentials are permanently readable in the Git commit tree.
remediation: Owner must revoke and rotate secret in Google Cloud Console. Purge .env.local from Git history using git-filter-repo.
business_impact: Unauthorized parties with repository access can impersonate the application in Google OAuth workflows.
effort: Low (1 hour + Google Cloud console rotation)

cwe: CWE-1333: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity / CWE-674: Uncontrolled Recursion
title: High Severity Denial-of-Service Vulnerabilities in npm Dependencies (braces/micromatch)
description: npm audit reports 5 high-severity vulnerabilities associated with braces package (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm), which allows uncontrolled resource consumption via crafted inputs.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Run npm audit --audit-level=high. 2. Review reported advisory GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm.
expected_behavior: All dependencies should be patched to secure versions without known high/critical CVEs.
observed_behavior: 5 high-severity vulnerabilities detected in build/lint dependency chain.
remediation: Configured package.json overrides for braces >=3.0.3 and micromatch >=4.0.8; verified installed braces version is 3.0.3.
business_impact: Build and lint pipeline denial of service or resource exhaustion.

title: Conditional Logic Engine Evaluation Defect Leaves Target Questions Visible
description: evaluateLogicRules initializes hiddenQuestionIds as an empty set. When a rule specifies action='show_question', if the condition evaluates to false, the question is never added to hiddenQuestionIds. As a result, questions meant to appear only conditionally remain permanently visible.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Create a form with Question A and Question B. 2. Add rule: 'Show Question B if Question A equals Yes'. 3. In public form, select 'No' for Question A. 4. Question B remains visible.
expected_behavior: Question B should be hidden by default and only displayed when Question A equals 'Yes'.
observed_behavior: Question B remains visible regardless of whether the condition is met.
remediation: evaluateLogicRules now initializes all questions targeted by 'show_question' rules as hidden by default, removing them only when matching conditions evaluate to true.
business_impact: Breaks conditional form branching; users encounter irrelevant questions and cannot submit forms due to unexpected mandatory field validations.

title: Synchronous Main-Thread localStorage Blocking and Quota Exhaustion Under Scale
description: internalDB performs synchronous JSON.stringify and JSON.parse on entire table arrays in localStorage on every single create, update, or read operation. For forms with hundreds of responses, this serializes several megabytes on the main UI thread, causing severe lag and UI freezing ('بطئ شديد'), and throws QuotaExceededError when reaching ~5MB.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Ingest 500 form responses into internalDB. 2. Edit a form question in the builder. 3. Observe main thread execution stalls and high CPU usage during JSON operations.
expected_behavior: Database operations should use in-memory caching with asynchronous IndexedDB persistence or direct Supabase streaming.
observed_behavior: Synchronous blocking of the JavaScript event loop during localStorage serialization.
remediation: Implemented L1 active memory caching layer with quota defense in internal-db.ts. Data reads are now instantaneous 0ms memory accesses.
business_impact: Direct root cause of user-reported extreme slowness ('بطئ شديد'); browser tabs become unresponsive when saving forms or viewing response tables.

title: O(Q x R x A) Algorithmic Bottleneck and Redundant Double-Fetch in Form Analytics
description: computeFormAnalytics executes nested loops iterating over every question, every response, and every answer (O(Q x R x A)), repeating linear scans across hundreds of thousands of operations. Furthermore, the responses page mounts by computing analytics from internalDB, and immediately re-computes them from dbService, doubling computation overhead.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Open responses page for a form with 30 questions and 500 responses. 2. Profile CPU performance in DevTools. 3. Observe 450,000+ iteration cycles and multiple consecutive re-renders.
expected_behavior: Answers should be indexed into a single Map<questionId, Answer[]> in O(R x A) time, and analytics computed in a single pass without double-invocations.
observed_behavior: Repeated nested array scans freeze UI rendering on page load.
remediation: Refactored computeFormAnalytics to linear O(R x A + Q) using Map indexing and constant-time option lookups. Memoized calculation with useMemo in responses page.
business_impact: Responses dashboard takes several seconds to render, causing browser frame drops and frustrating administrative users.

cwe: CWE-1025: Comparison of Incompatible Types / Layout Defect
title: Missing Dynamic dir='rtl' and Arabic Font Class Propagation on Public Forms Container
description: The root container of the public form view lacks an explicit dir={isAr ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'} attribute and font-cairo/font-sans typography classes. While individual input fields handle text alignment, layout containers, stepper badges, progress bars, and modal controls can render with misaligned LTR margins in Arabic locale.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Navigate to /ar/forms/p/[slug] in RTL browser mode. 2. Inspect root div at line 409. 3. Observe missing dir='rtl' attribute on form wrapper.
expected_behavior: Root layout wrapper should explicitly declare dir={isAr ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'} and apply appropriate Arabic font family styling.
observed_behavior: Container defaults to inherited layout without explicit RTL layout direction tokens.
remediation: Added dir={isAr ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'} and font-sans font-cairo classes to both the submitted screen and the active form card wrapper.
business_impact: Visual defects, inverted spacing, and degraded readability for Arabic-speaking respondents.

cwe: CWE-1078: Inappropriate Source Code Style or Formatting
title: Extensive Linter Violations (573 Problems Across Codebase)
description: npm run lint reports 573 problems (200 errors, 373 warnings). The codebase heavily utilizes @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any, contains unused imports and unhandled variables, obscuring subtle bugs and impeding automated CI quality gates.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Run npm run lint in project root. 2. Observe 573 linter violations.
expected_behavior: ESLint should pass with 0 errors and zero critical warnings.
observed_behavior: Linting fails with exit code 1 and 573 reported issues.
remediation: Replace any with strongly-typed interfaces from src/types/forms.ts, clean up unused imports, and configure automated pre-commit lint validation.
business_impact: High technical debt, elevated risk of regression during feature development, and lack of type-safety guarantees.

title: Question Editor Card Lacks Visual UI Controls for Numeric Min/Max Validation
description: While the backend validation engine supports min and max rules on numeric questions, the QuestionEditorCard component does not render numeric input fields allowing form creators to configure these limits visually.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Open Form Builder. 2. Add question of type 'Number'. 3. Observe absence of Minimum and Maximum value input fields in the card editor.
expected_behavior: Number questions should display input fields for 'Minimum Value' and 'Maximum Value' in the card settings.
observed_behavior: Creators cannot set numeric limits without manually editing raw JSON structures.
remediation: Added visual numeric inputs for 'Minimum Value' and 'Maximum Value' inside QuestionEditorCard when question.type === 'number'.
business_impact: Feature incompleteness: administrators cannot easily configure numeric constraints on application forms.
